Twelve comments

Third in the Blind Man Reel set

Here’s the third tune in the Blind Man Reel set asked for by Gael Force -- courtesy of Conan, who has also posted the second tune in the set (also a Gan Ainm, in A dorian at https://thesession.org/tunes/1297), so I’m afraid we’ve done a bit of cheat to get them both in on the same day, sorry, Jeremy. :)

↳ Posted by Zina Lee on January 6th, 2003.

Oh, I forgot to say…the liner notes on “Time on Our Hands” (Siobhan Peoples and box player Murty Ryan) say that this tune to them strongly resembles the Forfar Hunt.

↳ Posted by Zina Lee on January 6th, 2003.

A Scottish Tune

As Dunrobin Castle is a famous castle in the north of Scotland, it seems that the original tune is coming from there and as a bapipe tune.

It can be listened played by the Tannahil Weavers in 1976 here http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EhOPdJuLpH8

The notes are not exactly the same as the high B is not available on the great Highlands Bagpipes.

↳ Posted by JohnMcTilly on September 26th, 2012.
